summary: Oversized leaf, fails both leaf limits - same shape as the already-split WI-03b. Named changed subsystems count 4 against the 3-responsibility cap, and the body genuinely changes all four: per-predator controllers plus the non-chase hunting strategy and section 10 damage-model rules (creature simulation), CreatureDefs plus production spawns (world content data), data-driven predator body shapes plus visible pre-contact telegraph/commit on the WI-02b pipeline (procedural creature rendering, section 48), per-predator trigger-and-control scenarios plus the final roster-wide proof (headless scenario tests). The behavior is also not one: 4-6 creatures each with a distinct readable rule and a bespoke controller (section 19), each with its own independently testable headless scenario, plus the non-chase hunting strategy and the final roster-wide AC-roster-behavior proof - at least 6 independently testable behaviors. Sound parts to preserve: the three criteria are verbatim from ST-03, depends_on WI-03b is correct (now meaning all its leaves WI-03b1/2, which the final proof counts), the final AC-roster-behavior proof ownership is explicitly named, and the handoff is concrete. Useful split: promote WI-03c to stories/ST-WI-03c/plan.md (id WI-03c, kind: story, parent ST-03, depends_on WI-03b, all three criteria verbatim) with two leaves: (1) WI-03c1 - CreatureDefs plus per-predator controllers (bespoke up to ~120 lines per section 19 or generic state machine plus rules), the non-chase hunting strategy, section 10 damage model per size class, per-predator headless signature scenarios (trigger approach plus must-not-trigger control), and the FINAL PROOF for AC-roster-behavior (headless roster check over production world data, counting WI-03b1's friendly species) - subsystems: world content data, creature simulation, headless scenario tests; carries AC-roster-behavior and AC-roster-tests verbatim; (2) WI-03c2, depends_on WI-03c1 - tier-3 production spawns on section 39 bands with section 34 caps, data-driven predator body shapes plus telegraph/commit visibility on the existing WI-02b renderer, and the one tier browser spot-check - subsystems: world content data, procedural creature rendering; carries AC-roster-count and AC-roster-tests verbatim. Each child then has at most 3 changed subsystems and a strict subset of the parent's criteria; the union covers all three; WI-03d's whole-tier dependency is preserved by the promotion.
